Additionally, the specification incorrectly prints the count after processing each integer, whereas it should only print the final count after processing all integers.
Repair Directions:
1. Modify the condition to check if the difference between the indices of the two identical integers is exactly 2.
2. Remove the print statement inside the loop and only print the final count after processing all integers.
3. Ensure the function reads all necessary input before processing.
